bullets.section: Article I’m reading a second time —
bullets.title: Paul Singer, Doomsday Investor
bullets.note: (The New Yorker)**. This is a great profile of a fascinating investor, and it provides a good overview of “activist” investing. Paul is the founder of Elliott Management and, as put in the article, "one of the most powerful, and most unyielding, investors in the world."

bullets.title: Won't You Be My Neighbor?
bullets.note: This was repeatedly recommended to me by my good friend [Kevin Rose](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hk64nd/wwt2hghqe02vr/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW5zdGFncmFtLmNvbS9rZXZpbnJvc2Uv). I finally had a chance to watch it, and I wasn’t disappointed. It was particularly reassuring that Mister Rogers basically took the good TV playbook of the time and did the exact opposite, which helped lead to mega-success. Description: “Won't You Be My Neighbor? is a 2018 American documentary film directed by Morgan Neville about the life and guiding philosophy of Fred Rogers, the host and creator of Mister Rogers' Neighborhood. The trailer for the film debuted on what would have been Rogers' 90th birthday, March 20, 2018. It received acclaim from critics and audiences and has grossed $22 million, making it the highest-grossing biographical documentary of all time.” ([Wikipedia](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hk64nd/06cwh9h23l6wd/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvV29uJTI3dF9Zb3VfQmVfTXlfTmVpZ2hib3IlM0ZfKGZpbG0p)) If you don’t have time for the entire movie, [at least watch this amazing clip](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hk64nd/vws3hrhozw93o/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj1mS3k3bGpScjBBQQ==).

bullets.title: Corkcicle Whiskey Wedge
bullets.note: I learned of this fun device because it was created by a reader after he digested [_The 4-Hour Workweek_](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hk64nd/eebph7h78r3w4/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS80LUhvdXItV29ya3dlZWstRXNjYXBlLUxpdmUtQW55d2hlcmUvZHAvMDMwNzQ2NTM1Nw==), followed by [_One Simple Idea_](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hk64nd/oehkhqhw2qml5/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9PbmUtU2ltcGxlLUlkZWEtUmV2aXNlZC1FeHBhbmRlZC9kcC8xMjU5NTg5Njc2Lw==) by my friend and licensing expert Stephen Key. An overview of Stephen’s principles can also be found in this blog post: “[How to Rent Your Ideas to Fortune 500 Companies](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hk64nd/ppueh9h4nqw5r/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDA3LzExLzI2L2EtYmVnaW5uZXJzLWd1aWRlLWhvdy10by1yZW50LXlvdXItaWRlYXMtdG8tZm9ydHVuZS01MDAtY29tcGFuaWVzLXBsdXMtdmlkZW8vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTViZg==).” One note on the whiskey wedge that escapes some of the reviewers: ice does not stay ice forever. Thus, the whiskey wedge stays intact for 15-20 minutes in my experience, achieving the desired effect, but your mileage may vary. Once the ice melts a lot, it will float. #physics

bullets.title: C.L. Butaud’s 100% Texas tempranillo
bullets.note: , found at [Dai Due](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hk64nd/5kfvh7hgr6dox/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZGFpZHVlLmNvbS9ob21l) restaurant in Austin, Texas. Pairs well with the wild boar dishes (not kidding). When I think wine, Texas is not the first place that comes to mind. This is the first Texan wine I’ve really enjoyed rather than tolerated. I’m sure there are more out there and even more coming.
